subject: reasoning
question:
After interchanging the given two numbers and two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively?

+ and -, 6 and 9

I. 6 - 5 × 9 + 8 ÷ 2

II. 6 - 4 + 9 × 5 ÷ 3
solution:
According to the BODMAS rule,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f22f57d0cf5c493280a0ab6b7dbaea9e3fc5b035c6d410d59c2f476043bd03a8.png] 

Given Equations :

__
 
• 6 - 5 × 9 + 8 ÷ 2
 
• 6 - 4 + 9 × 5 ÷ 3

​Now,

I. 6 - 5 × 9 + 8 ÷ 2

After interchanging + and -, 6 and 9 respectively

⇒ 9 + 5 × 6 - **8 ÷ 2**

⇒ 9 + **5 × 6**** **- 4

⇒ **9**____** + 30**__ - 4

⇒ __**39 - 4**__ = **35.**

II. 6 - 4 + 9 × 5 ÷ 3

After interchanging + and -, 6 and 9 respectively

⇒ 9 + 4 -** 6 × 5 ÷ 3**

⇒ **__9 +____ 4__ - 10**

**⇒ __13 - 10__ = 3**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
